method: Typed C reconstruction of the SG-library file-slot operation, checked against the pinned executable's pseudocode and callers. Connects the SG3 reader to the native reload, aggregate counters, case-insensitive duplicate and tag-sync-warning behavior.

groups.previous_source_notes: The previous body is a Legacy bridge calling the generated image collection loader and is used only to cross-check call and result contracts.

verification.reason: The new slot manager path was exercised together with the reader for every installed SG3/555 pair; each case cycles a real slot index across 0 through 29.
